required_operating_characteristics: The operating capability depends on a renewable customer contract base, distributed local delivery, and demonstrated service execution.
Winning and retaining work requires more than immediately purchasable fixed assets.
required_company_conditions: The analysis can define a continuing operating perimeter and ordinary-share claim scope.
The analysis can distinguish customer acquisition, service delivery capability, project startup funding, and other functional assets without counting an economic cost twice.
non_applicability_conditions: Use is not appropriate when the company is valued principally as a liquidation, development-project, regulated-financial, or pre-revenue project vehicle.
Do not present a complete company-level replacement range when the required operating capabilities cannot be separately bounded or their overlap cannot be resolved.

components.requirement: Rebuild the continuing customer contract base and the retention capability needed for that base to remain economically usable.
components.unknown_semantics: An unbounded customer relationship rebuild cost remains UNKNOWN and prevents a complete company-level replacement range.
components.recognition_semantics: Recognize only a company-specific evidence-bounded range for capability not already recognized by another component.
components.completion_semantics: The required component is complete only when the rebuilding scope, evidence-bound range, recognition treatment, and overlap treatment are resolved.

components.requirement: Rebuild the regional operating organization, including the local management, staffing, operating systems, and ramp capability required to fulfil the customer base.
components.unknown_semantics: An unknown regional organization rebuild requirement remains UNKNOWN and prevents a complete company-level replacement range.
components.recognition_semantics: Recognize only the separately evidenced operating organization cost after excluding any customer acquisition or functional asset overlap.
components.completion_semantics: The required component is complete only when local coverage, staffing or system scope, ramp evidence, recognition treatment, and overlap treatment are resolved.

components.requirement: Rebuild the tender, referral, sales, and other customer-acquisition channels that provide a repeatable route to new work.
components.unknown_semantics: An unbounded channel rebuild cost remains UNKNOWN or SCENARIO_ONLY and prevents a complete company-level replacement range.
components.recognition_semantics: Recognize only the channel capability that is distinct from the customer relationship rebuild component.
components.completion_semantics: The required component is complete only when channel scope, repeatability, evidence-bound range, recognition treatment, and relationship overlap treatment are resolved.

components.requirement: Rebuild the qualifications, reference record, service execution record, and time-dependent credibility required to win and fulfil work.
components.unknown_semantics: An unbounded fulfilment record rebuild cost remains UNKNOWN or SCENARIO_ONLY and prevents a complete company-level replacement range.
components.recognition_semantics: Recognize only the independently evidenced qualification and delivery capability that is not already included in customer relationships or organization buildout.
components.completion_semantics: The required component is complete only when the qualification scope, delivery record, time to rebuild, recognition treatment, and overlap treatment are resolved.

components.requirement: Rebuild the project launch funding required before collections and settlements support an operating cohort.
components.unknown_semantics: An unbounded startup funding requirement remains UNKNOWN or SCENARIO_ONLY and prevents a complete company-level replacement range.
components.recognition_semantics: Recognize startup funding only once, after resolving whether the same economic need already belongs in balance-sheet working capital or EPV maintenance needs.
components.completion_semantics: The required component is complete only when the cohort cash sequence, evidence-bound range, destination owner, and recognition treatment are resolved.

components.requirement: Identify and rebuild any other separately evidenced functional asset necessary to provide the same continuing operating capability.
components.unknown_semantics: An identified but unbounded functional asset remains UNKNOWN or SCENARIO_ONLY and prevents a complete company-level replacement range.
components.recognition_semantics: Recognize only a separately evidenced functional asset after excluding items already represented by another replacement component or the claims bridge.
components.completion_semantics: The required component is complete only when the functional asset identity, operating necessity, evidence-bound range, recognition treatment, and overlap treatment are resolved.

likely_official_sources: Audited annual reports, contract disclosures, and exchange-filed operating updates that define the continuing customer or contract population.
query_hints: contracts under management customer mix renewable contracts
在管项目 客户结构 合约期限
evidence_role_guidance.bounded_stopping_rule: Check the current reporting-period filings, their customer or contract notes, and material operating announcements; if none defines the continuing population, record PUBLIC_INFO_UNAVAILABLE and keep this role missing.

likely_official_sources: Audited annual reports and exchange-filed operating reviews that disclose renewals, exits, retention, churn, or comparable contract cohorts.
query_hints: renewal retention churn contract exit cohort
续约率 退盘率 项目退出
evidence_role_guidance.bounded_stopping_rule: Check current and comparative official filings for renewal or exit cohorts; if no cohort-compatible disclosure exists, preserve UNKNOWN rather than infer retention from revenue growth.

likely_official_sources: Audited selling-expense notes, official tender records, and exchange-filed acquisition-channel disclosures.
query_hints: tender selling expense new contract acquisition cost
投标 营销费用 新签项目 获客成本
evidence_role_guidance.bounded_stopping_rule: Inspect current filings and official tender material for a company-specific rebuild-cost carrier; if only aggregate selling expense is available and cannot be attributed, record the attempt and leave the role missing.

likely_official_sources: Official contract histories, qualification rules, tender records, and exchange-filed descriptions of buildout or ramp periods.
query_hints: time to qualify ramp contract history tender eligibility
培育期 爬坡期 资质年限 投标资格
evidence_role_guidance.bounded_stopping_rule: Check official qualification and company filing sources for an observable recreation clock; if timing remains unstated, record PUBLIC_INFO_UNAVAILABLE and do not insert an industry-default duration.

likely_official_sources: Audited segment or geographic disclosures and exchange-filed operating statistics defining regional coverage and the continuing perimeter.
query_hints: geographic coverage regional platform managed cities
区域布局 城市覆盖 管理半径
evidence_role_guidance.bounded_stopping_rule: Use current official geographic and operating disclosures; if the continuing perimeter cannot be separated from disposed or non-core operations, keep the role missing and identify the perimeter conflict.

likely_official_sources: Audited employee disclosures, remuneration notes, and official descriptions of regional management and delivery roles.
query_hints: employees regional management staffing delivery personnel
员工构成 区域管理 项目人员
evidence_role_guidance.bounded_stopping_rule: Check official workforce and operating-organization disclosures; aggregate headcount without role or perimeter attribution is not enough, so record the limitation and preserve UNKNOWN.

likely_official_sources: Audited staff-cost notes and exchange-filed descriptions of recruitment, training, regional launch, or project ramp.
query_hints: recruitment training ramp regional launch staff cost
招聘 培训 爬坡 新区域 启动
evidence_role_guidance.bounded_stopping_rule: Inspect current filings for a company-specific recruitment or ramp carrier; if no attributable evidence exists, document the attempt and do not derive ramp cost from generic payroll ratios.

likely_official_sources: Audited operating reviews, service certifications, and official disclosures of systems, delivery capability, or regional control.
query_hints: operating platform service system delivery capability certification
运营平台 服务体系 履约能力 认证
evidence_role_guidance.bounded_stopping_rule: Check the current official operating description and certifications; marketing claims without a defined operating carrier remain ineligible and must not complete the role.

likely_official_sources: Official procurement platforms, tender eligibility rules, and exchange-filed descriptions of sales or referral channels.
query_hints: tender access procurement platform referral channel
招投标 准入 采购平台 推荐渠道
evidence_role_guidance.bounded_stopping_rule: Inspect official tender access rules and the company's filed channel description; if access cannot be tied to the current company, retain UNKNOWN rather than import an industry channel assumption.

likely_official_sources: Exchange-filed contract award statistics, official tender outcomes, and audited operating reviews with repeat-win evidence.
query_hints: contract wins bid success repeat customer third party expansion
中标率 新签合同 重复客户 第三方拓展
evidence_role_guidance.bounded_stopping_rule: Check current and comparative official award evidence; signed-value totals without a comparable opportunity set cannot establish conversion, so record the mismatch and leave the role missing.

likely_official_sources: Audited selling and tender-cost notes and exchange-filed channel investment disclosures.
query_hints: channel investment tender expense sales network rebuild
渠道投入 投标费用 销售网络
evidence_role_guidance.bounded_stopping_rule: Inspect official cost notes for an attributable channel-rebuild carrier; if costs overlap the customer-relationship component or remain aggregated, keep the role unresolved and identify the overlap.

likely_official_sources: Official tender rules, procurement notices, licences, certifications, and company-filed qualification disclosures.
query_hints: bid eligibility qualification licence certification service tender
投标资格 资质 许可证 服务认证
evidence_role_guidance.bounded_stopping_rule: Check authoritative tender and licensing rules relevant to the company's disclosed service scope; if eligibility is only asserted in promotional material, classify it as ineligible.

likely_official_sources: Official procurement rules, tender awards, customer notices, and exchange-filed contract or service-performance histories.
query_hints: past performance reference projects tender requirement service record
历史业绩 参考项目 投标要求 履约记录
evidence_role_guidance.bounded_stopping_rule: Inspect official rules and company-filed reference records; if the required history cannot be separated from related-party access or acquired entities, preserve UNKNOWN and state that boundary.

likely_official_sources: Official qualification rules, reference-period requirements, and exchange-filed project or capability buildout histories.
query_hints: required years experience qualification track record build period
从业年限 业绩要求 资质培育期
evidence_role_guidance.bounded_stopping_rule: Check official qualification clocks and company history; if no observable rebuild clock exists, keep timing UNKNOWN and prohibit a default ramp period.

likely_official_sources: Audited cost notes, capital expenditure disclosures, licences, system descriptions, and official capability buildout records.
query_hints: capability build cost licence system investment qualification
能力建设成本 系统投入 资质投入
evidence_role_guidance.bounded_stopping_rule: Inspect official cost and capability disclosures for a company-specific carrier; if capability is observable but cost is not bounded, retain the capability fact while leaving replacement cost UNKNOWN.

likely_official_sources: Audited working-capital notes, contract terms, and exchange-filed project launch and collection disclosures.
query_hints: project launch prepayment billing collection settlement cash sequence
项目启动 垫资 账单 回款 结算
evidence_role_guidance.bounded_stopping_rule: Check official contract and working-capital disclosures for a launch-to-collection sequence; a single balance-sheet date cannot establish the sequence, so preserve UNKNOWN when cohorts cannot be reconstructed.

likely_official_sources: Audited payroll, payable, receivable, contract-asset, and supplier-credit notes tied to project delivery.
query_hints: payroll supplier payment before collection contract assets
工资 供应商付款 回款前 合同资产
evidence_role_guidance.bounded_stopping_rule: Inspect official notes for pre-collection exposure on the relevant operating cohort; issuer-wide balances without project or period attribution remain insufficient.

likely_official_sources: Audited receivable ageing, impairment, contract-asset, collection, and settlement disclosures.
query_hints: receivable ageing collection settlement impairment contract asset
应收账龄 回款 结算 减值 合同资产
evidence_role_guidance.bounded_stopping_rule: Check current and comparative official ageing and collection disclosures; if project cohorts cannot be linked, record the attribution limit and do not convert aggregate improvement into a cohort history.

likely_official_sources: Audited balance-sheet notes and the current canonical working-capital and EPV model inputs.
query_hints: working capital maintenance need double count project startup
营运资本 维护需要 重复计值 项目启动
evidence_role_guidance.bounded_stopping_rule: Reconcile the same economic need across the official balance-sheet perimeter and canonical EPV inputs; if ownership cannot be resolved, exclude a complete company replacement range rather than choose a destination by default.

likely_official_sources: Audited fixed-asset, intangible-asset, software, licence, and operating-system disclosures.
query_hints: functional asset software licence operating system equipment
功能资产 软件 许可证 运营系统 设备
evidence_role_guidance.bounded_stopping_rule: Inspect official asset and operating disclosures; unidentified residual value is not a functional asset and must not be used as a balancing item.

likely_official_sources: Audited operating reviews, licence conditions, and official service-delivery requirements showing that the asset is necessary to continue operations.
query_hints: required for operations licence condition service delivery dependency
持续经营必需 许可条件 服务依赖
evidence_role_guidance.bounded_stopping_rule: Check official operating and regulatory sources for necessity; usefulness alone is insufficient, so leave the item outside the required replacement scope when necessity is not established.

likely_official_sources: Audited asset notes and current canonical replacement, working-capital, claims-bridge, and EPV model inputs.
query_hints: asset overlap customer relationship organization working capital EPV
资产重叠 客户关系 组织 营运资本 EPV
evidence_role_guidance.bounded_stopping_rule: Trace the asset to exactly one economic owner across canonical models; unresolved overlap blocks recognition and cannot be settled by assigning a residual percentage.

completion_rule.company_level_range: A company-level ordinary-equity or per-share replacement range is available only when every required component is bounded and recognized, or explicitly excluded with a resolved value destination owner.
completion_rule.incomplete_scope: Any required component that remains UNKNOWN or SCENARIO_ONLY leaves the company-level replacement range incomplete and prohibits a joint protection price.
completion_rule.epv_cross_check: Compare with EPV only after economic entity, operating perimeter, ordinary-share claim scope, currency, unit, and as-of basis are comparable; never add or average the ranges.
completion_rule.joint_protection: A common protection conclusion is permitted only when complete replacement and comparable EPV ranges exist on the same basis; it is not permitted from partial components.
